requirements.statement: TWI owns web acquisition only; Platform remains the sole identity, authorization, policy, approval, execution, evidence and audit authority.
TWI accepts Platform-issued audience-bound credentials and never trusts caller-supplied tenant or subject identifiers.
Acquisition results preserve source URL, retrieval timestamp, content digest and source-backed quote verification.
Job submission and World Intelligence evidence export are idempotent; retries require stable keys and conflicting replays fail closed.
Browser execution is isolated and cannot bypass the authenticated egress proxy.
World Intelligence receives source evidence through its contracted intake; TWI does not duplicate canonical entity resolution or temporal world state.
Request and W3C trace context are propagated across API, worker, and integration boundaries.
